sanskrit_verse:
अनादिर आत्मा संभूतिर् विद्यते नान्तरात्मनः ।
समवायी तु पुरुषो मोहेच्छाद्वेषकर्मजः ॥१२५॥
transliteration: anādir ātmā saṃbhūtir vidyate nāntarātmanaḥ | samavāyī tu puruṣo mohecchādveṣakarmajaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Self is without beginning; no birth or origin exists within It. Attachment, desire, hatred, and action cause the delusion of the embodied being who falsely identifies with the aggregate.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in the Atman, not in constructed identities
Causation arises from false identification, not inherent fault
Capacity-based responsibility lies in disidentification, not punishment
Restoration logic centers on dissolution of binding illusion
Consciousness alignment requires removal of superimposed conditioning
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent exhibits reactive behavior THEN initiate deconstructive inquiry into assumed identity
IF delusion is traced to samavāya-based misattribution THEN invoke non-binding realignment protocol
IF action stems from moha, icchā, or dvesha THEN activate pratyāhāra-based restoration sequence
IF self-attribution error occurs THEN deploy satvic capacity-reclamation mechanism
supreme_court_application: In adjudication, when intent or motive arises from attachment or aversion, the court shall recognize that the root error lies in identification with aggregates. The judgment must facilitate a process of unbinding rather than impose consequences based on assumed individual culpability.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: By pramāṇa, the causal chain begins in misrecognition (moha), followed by desire/aversion (icchā/dveṣa), leading to karmic entanglement. This sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) does not justify punitive response but necessitates a conscious reversal through discriminative awareness. Responsibility aligns with capacity to transcend conditioning, not to endure penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate viveka-vyapāśraya completion process to dissolve erroneous self-concept
Deploy ātma-pratipatti śuddhi protocol for reestablishing witness-consciousness integrity
Apply karma-viccheda upāya to neutralize compulsive patterns rooted in moha
Engage sattva-śuddhi dīkṣā for reintegration into non-reactive state of being
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. The law executes from the Self alone. Delusion has no ontological basis. Justice serves only restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
